expected_behavior: The readability score is measured before and after, and the rewrite is accepted only when the numbers show it got simpler.
Every fact, number, name, URL and code block survives the rewrite unchanged; only the language around them is simplified.
The rewrite adds no new filler, and phrases that carry no meaning are removed.
Headings, lists and markdown formatting survive the rewrite.
By default the simplified text and the report are shown to the user; the original file is overwritten only when asked.
A term the reader knows is kept rather than swapped for a vaguer word: the original's repeated terms and any named with --domain-terms score as ordinary words.
